lines.text: Time series intelligence meets real-time context. I B M Granite Time Series models now run live inside Confluent: pretrained and scalable, efficient on standard CPUs, and learning as each event lands.
Take one store on a hot day. The forecast reads the heat wave and sees the stockout coming, and an empty shelf is flagged in seconds.
Then it optimizes the next order to keep the shelf full, so mission-critical decisions land while they still matter.
Better together: Confluent streams, connects and governs the data, and Granite turns each event into a decision, with zero configuration.
For your teams: ten times faster time to value, five to ten percent more accuracy, and decisions in seconds.
Six mission-critical decisions, no data science team required: production, anomalies, supply chain, fraud, search and trading.
Live twins for industrial plants, retail, banking and airlines.
Proven in the field: tickets only on confirmed causes in telco, thirty models to two in cement, ten percent lower error in finance.
Bring us a stream and a decision. Contact us to start.
